subject: Assurance evidence ledger & control clarifications — Hightower RFP
messages:
From: Lauren Ortiz <procurement@hightower.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: security@hightower.com
Date: Fri, 02 Nov 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RFP: SIG/SOC2 evidence index request

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As part of our procurement packet we need a concise mapping of Redwood's SIG/SOC 2/ISO controls to the evidence deliverables you can provide. Attached is the latest Hightower questionnaire (SIG format) — we typically accept an evidence index (spreadsheet) that references files or shared links.

Can you confirm by COB Tuesday which artifacts you can supply and which need redaction or additional handling (e.g., KMS proofs, auditor summaries)? We're also tracking any items that require contractual non-disclosure or an executed DPA addendum.

Best,
Lauren Ortiz
Procurement Manager
Hightower Analytics

Attachment: Hightower_SIG_Questionnaire_v2.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Ortiz <procurement@hightower.com>
Cc: security@hightower.com, kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Nov 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP: SIG/SOC2 evidence index request

Hi Lauren — thanks for sending. We can put together a single evidence index (spreadsheet) that maps SIG control IDs to the artifacts we can share, with per-artifact delivery notes (link, PDF, or process excerpt) and any gating (e.g., requires PO, NDA, or viewer ACL). I've attached a working draft (redwood-evidence-index.xlsx) and an initial inventory of the typical SOC 2 artifacts we surface.

A couple quick clarifying Qs before we reconcile the full packet:
- Scope: do you want both SOC 2 Type II (production) and ISO 27001 control mappings, or SIG-only for the initial pass?
- Crypto/KMS: are you requesting a signed key-provenance statement (we can provide an auditor summary) or raw key material proofs?
- Delivery: would a shared Drive folder + time-limited links suffice, or do you require packaged PDFs for legal ingestion?

We'll aim to deliver a complete index and the initial set of shareable artifacts by EOD Tuesday if we have scope confirmed today.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-evidence-index.xlsx

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Nov 2028 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: FW: RFP: SIG/SOC2 evidence index request

Team — forwarding Hightower's ask. They want an evidence index that maps SIG controls to files/links and flags anything that needs NDA/PO gating. Please add a single-line item per artifact into the attached workbook: artifact name | control IDs | owner | shareable? (Y/N) | redaction required? (Y/N) | expected delivery date.

Owners:
- Kimberly: user access, SSO, provisioning logs (we should include the idempotent log pull and retention policy excerpt).
- Marissa: policy artifacts, SOC 2 + ISO summaries, and auditor letter templates.
- Jonas: KMS/key custody statements + any cryptographic proofs; check with infra on whether we can provide a signed provenance PDF (we have an auditor summary in the vault).

Deadline: COB Monday (2028-11-05) for all rows; if you cannot meet that, flag now and I'll call out exceptions to Lauren. Keep entries short — they'll ingest this into their vendor assurance tracker.

Thanks — Priyom
